# StackPilot

Your infrastructure, explained

StackPilot maps every service, cost and dependency, then answers questions about your stack in plain English.

## Features

### Live service map

Generated from what is actually running.

### Cost per feature

See what each product area really costs.

### Ask anything

Plain-English answers about your own stack.

## Who it is for

Platform engineers.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
